node.html: A web app that helps students find professors matching their research background and reach out for funded PhD/Masters positions. It reads the student's CV, ranks professors by research fit, and writes personalized funding-request emails that are sent from the student's own Gmail.

A free, open-source Bangla AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) app that gives non-verbal children a voice. Children tap picture tiles and the app speaks a full, grammatical Bangla sentence. It pairs a deterministic grammar engine (the safety-critical path) with a fine-tuned BanglaT5 neural composer trained on self-generated, order-shuffled data — reaching near-perfect exact match on tile combinations it never saw in training.
Developed a full department-based chatbot for Microfin360 using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide accurate responses to department-specific queries during internship at DataSoft.

Developed a 2D obstacle-avoidance game where players control a car that jumps over dynamic obstacles like trees and stones. Implemented collision detection, physics-based jump mechanics, and progressive difficulty using Python and OpenGL.

Designed and implemented a web-based flight booking platform supporting both one-way and round-trip searches with advanced filtering options. Integrated secure authentication, automated e-ticket issuance, and invoice generation. Developed an admin dashboard to manage flights, routes, fares, and passenger records.
